Our Story · Established August 1989

Serving South Florida Real Estate Since 1989

First Capital Group, Inc. was founded in August of 1989 by Miami Real Estate Broker Anvar B. Moghaddam. Our main objective has always been to serve Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach County with all of their real estate needs.

For more than 20 years, First Capital Group, Inc. has helped the citizens of South Florida purchase properties and understand and execute real estate instruments. With our dedicated team, we work to tackle each deal with care, commitment, and personal attention.

Pinecrest, Florida

Pinecrest Luxury Homes

Pinecrest is one of South Florida’s most sought-after addresses — known for gated estates, Mediterranean and modern contemporary residences, waterfront settings, and lush tropical landscaping with resort-style pools.

First Capital Group guides buyers and sellers through this distinctive market with local knowledge and personal attention.

South Florida & Statewide

Serving Buyers and Sellers Across All of Florida

Our roots are in Miami and Pinecrest, but our reach is statewide. First Capital Group represents clients buying, selling, and renting throughout Florida — from the Keys to the Panhandle — with the same personal attention whether your home is in Miami-Dade or beyond.

HUD Homes

Licensed HUD Homes Agent

First Capital Group is a licensed HUD homes agent. HUD homes are government-owned properties that may offer opportunities for owner-occupants, first-time buyers, and investors. We help you understand the process, search available HUD properties, and submit offers.

HUD bidding periods, eligibility, and terms are set by HUD and subject to change. [Add your HUD registration/ID details here.]
